title: Arousal Index (ArI)
lesson: A sleep index expresses how often an event occurs per hour. For arousal index, the event count is the number of scored arousals and the denominator is total sleep time in hours.
memoryClue: Count the arousals, divide by sleep hours.
coachBobNote: The most common index mistake is using minutes as though they were hours. Convert TST or multiply the per-minute rate by 60.

variables.unit: hours or minutes converted to an hourly rate
